first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation by improving time-to-value. It has stronger alignment with sustainable qualified revenue than reacting immediately with discounts, which could lift acquisition while weakening customer quality or unit economics. Verify the strongest evidence for onboarding, pricing, and activation messaging before committing; the current preference remains onboarding simplification.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified evidence shows gains in completion (+13%), time-to-value (-2.1 days), and 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable revenue. Activation messaging is a credible alternative, but has a smaller verified retention gain. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its +18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with a 12% retention decline and failure by first renewal.
